title: Sources: US officials told Congressional staffers that there is no evidence MSS directed Alice Huang to spy on Jensen Huang and the affair may have been amorous (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: US officials told Congressional staffers that there is no evidence MSS directed Alice Huang to spy on Jensen Huang and the affair may have been amorous — The classified discussion happened just one day after the Trump administration helped reinstall Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
